AUTHOR: Lopez-Vazquez
TITLE: Deep learning based deep-sea automatic image enhancement and animal species classification
REGION: Barkley Canyon Hydrates site (~870 m), NEPTUNE/Ocean Networks Canada, NE Pacific, Canada
SPECIES: Sebastidae (Sebastes/Sebastolobus), Bathyagonus nigripinnis, Eptatretus stoutii (fish); Chionoecetes tanneri, Asteroidea, Bolinopsis infundibulum, Poralia rufescens (invertebrates); plus floating particles, objects, other species
DATA: Own footage from the Internet Operated Vehicle (crawler) 'Wally', 18 transects, 2 Nov - 2 Dec 2016, 1 Hz Basler camera; 13,548 images for enhancement network, 6,972 labelled elements for classification
V_EV: Data collection: 'did not impede the generation of sediment cloud, parts of which would occasionally interfere with the camera's field of view'; Discussion: 'depths of more than 800 m, where visibility is low'
D2: 80/20 (5,573 train elements augmented to 35,020 / remainder test); tenfold cross-validation; enhancement net 80/20 (10,838 / 2,710 images)
D_EV: Experimental design: 'we decided to apply data augmentation techniques to 80% of the images (a total of 5573 images), which are the ones that made up the training set' ... 'All the selected classifiers were tested by tenfold cross-validation'
R_EV: Experimental design: 'a dataset of 13,548 images was used to create the training and test data sets' (single crawler dataset, same site and month)
C_EV: Classification metrics: 'Accuracy', 'The Area Under the Receiver Operating characteristic Curve (AUROC)', 'Loss', 'The confusion matrix' (classification of pre-detected elements only; no detection/counting evaluation)
E_EV: Abstract/Results: 'accuracy value of 66.44% and an Area Under the ROC Curve (AUROC) value of 82.91%, which were subsequently improved to 79.44% and 88.64%' (classification metrics only)
ARCH: Image enhancement: 14-layer residual convolutional autoencoder (Adam, MSE) trained on WB/GC/CLAHE-processed targets; classification: frame-difference detection + 8 classical classifiers (LSVM, SVM_SGD, k-NN x2, DT x2, RF x2) and 8 neural nets (CNN-1..4, DNN-1..4) from Lopez-Vazquez et al. 2020 [57]
METR: UIQM, UCIQE, SSIM, PSNR (image quality); accuracy, AUROC, loss, confusion matrix (classification)
NOTE: Primarily an image-enhancement + species-classification study; fish are 3 of 10 classes (others are invertebrates, particles, objects), so TAXA/NCLASS are for all classes. PLAT: benthic crawler (Internet Operated Vehicle docked to a cabled observatory) coded as ROV/AUV (closest allowed value). V: no quantitative turbidity; sediment clouds, darkness and low visibility described qualitatively; depth (870 m) and artificial LED illumination (2 x 33 W) reported (V2/V3 read as depth/illumination); UIQM and UCIQE are reported for enhanced images (V5=UIQM, UCIQE also given) but performance is stratified by enhancement variant, not by visibility (V6=N). D: element-level random 80/20 plus tenfold CV; consecutive 1 Hz frames of the same animal could fall in both folds; no de-duplication or leakage discussion -> D_ALL=N. C_ALL=NA: evaluation is pure classification of detected/cropped elements (accuracy/AUROC); the frame-difference detection step is not evaluated and no confidence threshold is reported — verifier may prefer NR. PRE=없음: custom small networks trained from scratch, transfer learning named only as future work. Raw footage archived in ONC Oceans 2.0 (DSHR=공개); no code.
